name: Heroes from the Age of Gods — Ragnarok Unbound
setText:
Set Routines
      Round 1 - Set Phase
      Name     Invasion of Myth
               Place 1 “War Marker” each in Garden 1 and Garden 4.
               War Marker: While a character is in a Garden with this marker,
      Effect
               their Defense lowers by 1. This represents the area turning into a
               chaotic melee of heroic phantoms.
               A raging storm, thunder crashing, and the shadows of countless
      Flavor
               heroes appear.

      Round 2 - Set Phase
      Name     Mythic Archetype
      Effect   The enemy recovers [1 die] Endurance.
      Flavor   A hero possesses the enemy.

      Round 3 - Set Phase
  From round 3 onward, repeat the same Set routine as round 2.




208

actions.name: Arm of Silver
actions.text:
Name     Arm of Silver
          When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against
          all Stellar Knights in the Enemy's same Garden. Afterward, roll a
 Effect
          [5 dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights in the Garden
          directly opposite the Enemy's.
          A silver light courses through the enemy’s right arm. The
 Flavor
          legendary power of the Shining Arm is now unleashed.

actions.name: Shining Sword
actions.text:
Name     Shining Sword
          When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against
 Effect
          all Stellar Knights in the Enemy's same & adjacent Gardens.
          The enemy’s weapon glows brilliantly. Here, the legend of the
 Flavor
          Shining Sword is reborn.

actions.name: Unerring Spear
actions.text:
Name     Unerring Spear
          When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against
 Effect
          all Stellar Knights in Gardens 1, 3, and 5.
          The legendary spear that never misses when thrown. A spear of
 Flavor
          light is released from the enemy’s right arm.

actions.name: The Three Goddesses
actions.text:
Name     The Three Goddesses
          The Enemy recovers 3 Endurance, then places 1 Set die on any
 Effect
          skill and uses it immediately.
          Three goddesses descend, bestowing various blessings upon the
 Flavor
          enemy.

actions.name: Goddess of War
actions.text:
Name     Goddess of War
          When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against
 Effect
          all Stellar Knights in Gardens 2, 3, and 6.
          The war goddess descends by the enemy’s side. Her spear strikes
 Flavor
          at the Stellar Knights.

name: Resplendent Blade Dance
setText:
Set Routines
       Round 1 - Set Phase
       Name     Lo, was that a starving wolf’s distant howl
                This effect executes at the start of Round 1’s Cut phase. Target
                the Stellar Knight who is furthest from the Enemy's Garden (if
       Effect
                multiple are equally distant, the Director chooses 1). Roll a [(3 +
                Round count) dice Attack check] against the target.
                Across the wind-swept arena, the howl of a wolf echoes far away.
      Flavor    As if threatening to devour cowards, it seems to be watching,
                waiting.

       Round 2 - Set Phase
      From round 2 onward, repeat the same Set routine as round 1.




210

actions.name: Now’s the Moment! Waterfowl Scatter in Alarm!
actions.text:
Name     Now’s the Moment! Waterfowl Scatter in Alarm!
          The enemy places 1 Set die on any skill and uses it immediately.
 Effect
          During this action, the enemy rolls 2 extra dice on any Attack check.
          Perhaps startled by a sudden gust, flocks of birds take flight with a
 Flavor   clamor. Amid their shadows, a deadly blade strikes at the Stellar
          Knights!

actions.name: Let the Fallen Soldiers’ Regrets Become Blades
actions.text:
Name     Let the Fallen Soldiers’ Regrets Become Blades
          Place a Ghost Blade Marker in every Garden.
 Effect   Ghost Blade Marker: Whenever a Stellar Knight rolls a die that
          matches their location's Garden #, they take [Round count] damage.
          Countless swords are thrust into the battlefield. Suddenly, they
 Flavor
          begin to dance, ready to devour anyone who lowers their guard.

actions.name: Even the Wind Delights in This Duel!
actions.text:
Name     Even the Wind Delights in This Duel!
          Roll a [4 dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights in Gardens
 Effect
          1, 3, and 5.
          Is it the countless exchange of swords, or does the wind itself thrill
 Flavor   at the duel? Whirling gusts turn into blades and lash out at the
          Stellar Knights!

actions.name: I’d like to see you try, the Barehanded Sword Catch!!
actions.text:
Name     I’d like to see you try, the Barehanded Sword Catch!!
          The enemy and the closest Stellar Knight each roll 5 dice and total
 Effect   the results. The one with the lower total takes 5 damage. (For
          extra excitement, you can alternate rolling the dice one at a time!)
          Empowered by the stage, the enemy’s weapon grows massive and
 Flavor   razor-sharp. Can the Stellar Knight catch a strike at this blinding
          speed?!

actions.name: What a Thrilling Duel!
actions.text:
Name     What a Thrilling Duel!
          The enemy places 1 Set die on any skill and uses it immediately.
 Effect
          Then, the enemy recovers [1 die] Endurance.
          The fierce clash between Stellar Knight and enemy continues; a
 Flavor
          battle of life and death that, in the end, nourishes the enemy’s soul.

name: Deep Sea
setText:
Set Routines
       Round 1 - Set Phase
       Name     Giant Shark Attack
                Place a “Shark Marker” in Garden 1.
                Shark Marker: Any Stellar Knight that enters the marked Garden
       Effect
                takes [1 + Round count] damage. Any still in this Garden when the
                “Cut phase” occurs takes an additional [1 + Round count] damage.
                A massive shark bursts from the sea, biting into the stage. One bite
      Flavor
                from those jaws would leave more than just a scratch.

       Round 2 - Set Phase
       Name     Giant Wave
                All Stellar Knights move 1 space toward Garden 1. This movement
       Effect   cannot be indirect. (For example, if you’re in Garden 2, you must
                move toward Garden 1, not Garden 3.)
      Flavor    A wave so large crashes in that it tilts the entire stage.

       Round 3 - Set Phase
      From round 3 onward, repeat the same Set routine as round 2.




212

actions.name: Tentacle Assault
actions.text:
Name     Tentacle Assault
          When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against all
 Effect
          Stellar Knights in Gardens 2, 4, and 6.
          Multiple tentacles rise from the sea, lashing out at the Stellar
 Flavor
          Knights.

actions.name: Flying Fish Barrage
actions.text:
Name     Flying Fish Barrage
          When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against all
 Effect
          Stellar Knights in Gardens 3, 4, and 5.
          Countless flying fish leap from the waves, attacking the Stellar
 Flavor
          Knights like bullets.

actions.name: Sudden Torrent
actions.text:
Name     Sudden Torrent
          All Stellar Knights roll [1 die]. Those rolling 4+ remain in place.
 Effect
          Those rolling 3 or lower move to Garden 1.
          The tail strike of a massive whale creates a violent current. Can
 Flavor
          you withstand the force as it sweeps across the stage?

actions.name: Sea Serpent Crush
actions.text:
Name     Sea Serpent Crush
          Roll an [8 dice Attack check] against the Stellar Knight with the
          highest Endurance. Then, all other Stellar Knights in the target's
 Effect
          same Garden take [1 + Round count] damage and move 1 space.
          Each Stellar Knight chooses their own destination.
          A towering sea serpent crashes down onto the stage from above.
 Flavor
          Getting hit by something that massive would be devastating.

actions.name: Tentacle Sweep
actions.text:
Name     Tentacle Sweep
          Roll a separate [2 dice Attack check] against each Stellar Knight.
 Effect   Any who takes even 1 point of damage moves 1 space clockwise
          (for example, a damaged Knight in Garden 3 moves to Garden 4).
          A giant octopus rises from the sea, its massive tentacles sweeping
 Flavor
          across the stage.

name: Plushie Collection
setText:
Set Routines
       Round 1 - Set Phase
       Name     Fluffy soft and puffy ♪
       Effect   Until the end of this round, the Enemy’s Defense raises by 1.
                The ground is plush and bouncy! ♪ A fluffy bed, with pillowy
      Flavor
                cushions all around. ♪ Huh? The footing’s unstable? Who cares?

       Round 2 - Set Phase
      Name      Piping Hot Pancakes ♪
      Effect    All Stellar Knights take [their Garden's #] damage.
      Flavor    Wait—piping hot pancakes are falling from the sky!?

       Round 3 - Set Phase
      From round 3 onward, repeat the same Set routine as round 2.




214

actions.name: Bouncy Bunny ♪ (Spring-Loaded Neck)
actions.text:
Name     Bouncy Bunny ♪ (Spring-Loaded Neck)
          When this effect is executed, all Stellar Knights compare their Garden #s. Roll
 Effect
          a [7 dice Attack check] against the Knight in the lowest numbered Garden.
 Flavor   Who should I play with today? The bunny plush tilts its head (baring its fangs).

actions.name: Fluffy Cat’s Big Jump (Fat Cat Press)
actions.text:
Name     Fluffy Cat’s Big Jump (Fat Cat Press)
          When this effect is executed, all Stellar Knights compare their Garden #s. Roll
 Effect
          a [7 dice Attack check] against the Knight in the highest numbered Garden.
 Flavor   Boing! ♪ The big cat plush leaps up. Looks like it wants to play! ♪

actions.name: Mr. Bear’s Trial (Who’s Been Naughty?)
actions.text:
Name     Mr. Bear’s Trial (Who’s Been Naughty?)
          When the Omen is read, the Enemy rolls [1 die]. When this effect is
          executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights in the
 Effect
          Garden matching the rolled number. If no one is in that Garden, roll a [4
          dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights instead.
          The giant teddy bear plush spins around in place. When it stops, it points to
 Flavor
          a spot. Looks like you’re the naughty one today! ♪

actions.name: Mr. Bear’s Grand Trial (The Bear Trials Return)
actions.text:
Name     Mr. Bear’s Grand Trial (The Bear Trials Return)
          When the Omen is read, the Enemy rolls [1 die]. When this effect is
          executed, roll a [6 dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights in the
 Effect
          Garden matching the rolled number. If no one is in that Garden, roll a [4
          dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights instead.
          The giant teddy bear plush spins around in place. When it stops, it points to
 Flavor
          a spot. The real culprit... is you!

actions.name: Mr. Bear’s Ultimate Trial (Bear Revolution)
actions.text:
Name     Mr. Bear’s Ultimate Trial (Bear Revolution)
          When the Omen is read, the Enemy rolls [1 die]. When this effect is
          executed, roll a [7 dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights in the
 Effect
          Garden matching the rolled number. If no one is in that Garden, roll a [4
          dice Attack check] against all Stellar Knights instead.
          The giant teddy bear plush spins around in place. When it stops, it points to
 Flavor
          a spot. That wasn't the source of the problem... You’re the one causing it!!!

name: My Giant Robot
setText:
Set Routines
       Round 1 - Set Phase
       Name     Dramatic Boarding!
                Until this Stellar Battle ends, the Enemy rolls 1 extra die on all
       Effect   Attack checks. This only applies to Skill-based Attack checks, and
                not those by the Stage's effects.
                A giant robot suddenly appears at the Enemy's side. Now, the pilot
      Flavor
                and machine become one!

       Round 2 - Set Phase
       Name     Irregular
                The Enemy recovers [1 die] Endurance, and then rolls a [1 die
       Effect
                Charge check].
                A genius among thousands—no, tens of thousands—stands here.
      Flavor
                The Enemy truly dominates the battlefield.

       Round 3 - Set Phase
      From round 3 onward, repeat the same Set routine as round 2.




216

actions.name: Slicing Light Blade
actions.text:
Name     Slicing Light Blade
          When this effect is executed, roll a [7 dice Attack check] against all
 Effect
          Stellar Knights in the Enemy's same & directly opposite Gardens.
          Countless particles of light swirl around the enemy. They converge,
 Flavor
          and in a single radiant flash, streak across the stage!

actions.name: Burst, Radiant Shield!!
actions.text:
Name     Burst, Radiant Shield!!
          When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check] against all
 Effect
          Stellar Knights in the Enemy's same & adjacent Gardens.
          The giant robot’s shield of light shatters, unleashing a powerful
 Flavor
          explosion all around.

actions.name: Wild Dancing Lights
actions.text:
Name     Wild Dancing Lights
 Effect   Each Stellar Knight takes [their Garden's #] damage.
          Cloaked in shimmering particles, the giant robot dashes wildly
 Flavor
          across the battlefield, attacking the Stellar Knights!

actions.name: PILE... DRIVER!!!
actions.text:
Name     PILE... DRIVER!!!
          Roll an [8 dice Attach check] against the Stellar Knight with the
 Effect   highest Endurance. Afterwards, that Stellar Knight moves 1 space,
          chosen by the Enemy.
 Flavor   A massive pile driver slams down into a Stellar Knight!

actions.name: Annihilation Mode
actions.text:
Name     Annihilation Mode
          The enemy places 1 Set die on any skill and uses it immediately.
 Effect   If an "Attack check" is rolled with this skill, add 1 extra die to the
          roll.
 Flavor   The robot’s eyes glow a deep red...

name: The Midnight Ball
setText:
Set Routines
       Round 1 - Set Phase
      Name      Resplendent, Lavish Ball
      Effect    Until this round ends, the Action routine's "Effect 1" takes place.
      Flavor    Lively music, cheerful chatter, light-footed dancing.

       Round 2 - Set Phase
       Name     Seductive, Massacre Ball
       Effect   Until this round ends, the Action routine's "Effect 2" takes place.
                Warped music, guests drawing rapiers, swirling with a sinister air,
      Flavor
                murderous intent baring its fangs.

       Round 3 - Set Phase
      From round 3 onward, alternate between Round 1 & 2's Set routines.




218

actions.name: Whispered Conversation
actions.text:
Name     Whispered Conversation
          Effect 1: when this effect is executed, all Stellar Knights in Gardens
          2, 4, and 6 recover 1 Endurance, and the Enemy recovers 4
 Effect   Endurance.
          Effect 2: When this effect is executed, roll a [6 dice Attack check]
          against all Stellar Knights in Gardens 2, 4, and 6.
          Faceless guests approach the Stellar Knights, speaking softly. In
 Flavor
          their hands, a (1: wine glass / 2: blood-soaked rapier).

actions.name: Lighthearted Dance
actions.text:
Name     Lighthearted Dance
          Effect 1: The Enemy recovers 1 Endurance, then places 1 Set die on
          any skill and immediately uses it.
 Effect
          Effect 2: When this effect is executed, roll a [5 dice Attack check]
          against all Stellar Knights in Gardens 1, 3, and 5.
          To the orchestra’s music, the faceless guests dance (1: joyfully / 2:
 Flavor
          with steps stained in blood).

actions.name: The Prince & the Girl
actions.text:
Name     The Prince & the Girl
          Effect 1: The Stellar Knight with the lowest Endurance recovers 1
          Endurance and moves to the same Garden as the Enemy.
 Effect   Effect 2: Roll a [9 dice Attack check] against the Stellar Knight
          with the highest Endurance, then move that Stellar Knight to the
          same Garden as the Enemy.
          A (1: commoner girl / 2: Stellar Knight) is chosen by the prince
 Flavor
          and invited to a (1: dance / 2: dance of death).

name: Dragon God Extermination
setText:
Set Routines
      Round 1 - Set Phase
      Name     The Great Dragon's Arrival
               All Stellar Knights roll [1 die]. Those with rolls of 5+ nothing
      Effect   happens. On a 4 or lower, the Knight is forcibly moved 1 space
               toward Garden 1 and takes damage equal to the result they rolled.
               Dark clouds gather as the dragon approaches from afar, like a
      Flavor   coming storm. Its massive form rushes in at high speed, whipping
               up a violent gale that threatens to sweep the Stellar Knights away!

      Round 2 - Set Phase
      Name     Dragon Knight
               From this point forward, all Enemy Attack checks roll with 1
      Effect
               extra die.
               The Enemy mounts the back of the great dragon. From here on, the
      Flavor
               attacks will only grow more fierce.

      Round 3 - Set Phase
  From round 3 onward, there is no Set routine.




220

actions.name: Dragon's Breath
actions.text:
Name     Dragon's Breath
          When this effect is executed, roll a [7 dice Attack check] against all
 Effect
          Stellar Knights in Gardens 1, and 4.
          The great dragon unleashes a torrent of flame, scorching the stage
 Flavor
          like a raging flood.

actions.name: Lesser dragons appear
actions.text:
Name     Lesser dragons appear
          When this effect is executed, roll a [6 dice Attack check] against all
 Effect
          Stellar Knights in Gardens 2, 4, and 6.
          Countless draconic minions, kin of the great dragon, swoop in and
 Flavor
          launch a relentless wave attack on the Stellar Knights.

actions.name: Giant Tail Slam
actions.text:
Name     Giant Tail Slam
          When this effect is executed, roll a [7 dice Attack check] against
 Effect
          all Stellar Knights in Gardens 3, and 6.
          The great dragon soars high, then brings its massive tail crashing
 Flavor
          down onto the stage.

actions.name: Ominous Stillness
actions.text:
Name     Ominous Stillness
          The Enemy recovers 4 Endurance, then places 1 Set die on any
 Effect
          skill and uses it immediately.
          The great dragon is seemingly perched high above, gathering
 Flavor   strength. But don't let your guard down. The Enemy closes in on
          the Stellar Knights in an instant!

actions.name: A flame that chars all black
actions.text:
Name     A flame that chars all black
          All Stellar Knights roll [1 die]. If the result is 3 or lower, nothing
 Effect   happens. If the result is 4+, that Stellar Knight takes [their result
          +2] damage.
          With a roar from the great dragon, all of its kin unleash their
 Flavor
          powerful dragon breaths in unison.
